headline: Wall Street Nervousness & Inflation Worries
detail: Rising yields and inflation concerns create market turbulence. This macro backdrop is a headwind for your concentrated tech and leveraged ETF holdings, increasing downside risk.
rec: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL given their leveraged nature and current market jitters.

headline: Nvidia AI Platform for Retailers
detail: Nvidia's AI expansion into retail logistics is positive for the company. This highlights continued innovation in the chip sector, which is your core focus.
rec: Monitor NVDA's scanner setup (entry 218.59-218.20, stop 217.06) as a potential point of interest if you decide to add to chip exposure.

headline: 10-Year Yield Hits Highest Since January 2025
detail: Higher oil prices are fueling inflation worries, pushing yields up. This is a direct macro signal that can pressure growth stocks and leveraged ETFs, amplifying your margin risk.
rec: Re-evaluate your exposure to SOXL and SPAL. Their leveraged nature makes them particularly vulnerable to rising rates and inflation fears.
